entities.name: Synopsys
entities.summary: Synopsys (NASDAQ:SNPS). EDA + design-IP leader pivoting to 'Silicon to Systems' via Ansys acquisition — integrated silicon + multi-physics platform. FY2025 fiscal year ended 2025-10-31; 10-K filed 2025-12-22. AI portfolio: Synopsys.ai suite (DSO.ai, VSO.ai, TSO.ai, ASO.ai), Synopsys.ai Copilot, Design.da / Silicon.da analytics.

entities.name: Cadence Design Systems
entities.summary: Cadence (NASDAQ:CDNS). EDA + system-design + IP leader pivoting to 'Intelligent System Design (ISD)' via SD&A + bolt-on M&A. FY2025 fiscal year ended 2025-12-31; 10-K filed 2026-02-19. AI portfolio: Cerebrus agentic AI, JedAI platform, Verisium (AI verification), Allegro X AI for PCB. Three explicit AI horizons: Infrastructure AI, Physical AI, Life Sciences AI.

entities.name: Ansys
entities.summary: Multi-physics simulation leader; acquired by Synopsys (the core pivot move from EDA to broader silicon + multi-physics).

entities.name: DSO.ai
entities.summary: Synopsys' AI-driven place-and-route optimisation tool — most-cited AI-EDA name in industry.

entities.name: JedAI
entities.summary: Cadence's AI platform powering Cerebrus and Verisium.

entities.name: Qualcomm
entities.summary: Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM). Smartphone-SoC leader pivoting toward Data Center via Alphawave acquisition (closed 2025-12-18). FY25 Q3 revenue USD 10.4 bn → FY26 Q2 USD 10.6 bn (Q3 FY26 guidance midpoint USD 9.6 bn). Q2 FY26 events: USD 5.7 bn DTA release, USD 20 bn buyback authorisation. FY25 10-K (filed 2025-11-05) named Data Center as a new reportable segment after OBBB enactment.

entities.name: Alphawave
entities.summary: Alphawave Semi — SerDes / high-speed-interconnect IP company; acquired by Qualcomm (closed 2025-12-18). Core asset for Qualcomm's Data Center segment build-out.
